annotations.text:
OPTION A — Gallery-Forward
Imagery leads: a spotlight order with a large thumbnail, then a 4-up card grid where every order carries a placeholder image first, metadata second. Closest to the image-first principle, most visually distinct from a generic SaaS dashboard.

Tradeoff: with no real photos yet, the placeholder tiles are doing a lot of visual work — this direction depends most on real imagery arriving to reach its full effect.

OPTION B — Timeline-Forward
Status leads: a production-pipeline strip shows counts per stage, orders render as compact rows with an inline progress bar instead of a thumbnail. Strongest 'what's happening right now' trust signal; scales well to many orders.

Tradeoff: least image-first of the three — closest in spirit to the old admin-style density, just better executed. Good fit if the customer's real priority is status clarity over visual browsing.

OPTION C — Editorial Hybrid
A dark, grain-textured header with a large Instrument Serif greeting sets an editorial tone, then settles into a refined list (not a grid) plus a spotlight card and compact stat/CTA panels on the right.

Tradeoff: the most 'premium brand' feeling of the three, but the header is the boldest structural departure — worth checking it doesn't read as a marketing-page hero bleeding into product UI.
